lines.text: The LORD gives Jeremiah a word about a drought, and the nobles' servants find no water in the cisterns.
The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen, and the doe deserts her fawn because there is no grass.
The people confess their sins and ask the LORD to act for the sake of His name, saying He is among them.
The LORD tells Jeremiah not to pray for the people, and says He will finish them off by sword and famine and fire.
The prophets promise lasting peace, but the LORD says He did not send them, and the people will be thrown into the streets of Samaria.
